messages:
lee_procure: Heads up — HyperPlane just notified us that the H100 allocation for Wave-7 is delayed. vendor says 40/100 units are DOA or being RMA'd, ETA for replacements is 'staggered' over 2–3 weeks. asking: can we split the shipment/credit + provisional top-up?
maria_ops: Oof. which regions affected? do we have a list of serials impacted?
sam_hyperplane: hi team — sorry about this. affected SKUs: H100-80C, batch 7. Serial batch: HP7-2200 to HP7-2299 (approx). Current plan: 40 units return->RMA, 60 units ship next business day. replacements will be sent in two waves: 15 units week1, 25 units week2. we'll issue a provisional credit for 30% of unit cost while investigating DOA cause.
jordan_logistics: what's the AWB/manifest for the partial ship? any customs HS reclassifications needed for replacements?
rma_bot: RMA created: HP-RMA-4572. Escalation level: vendor-respawn. Tracker: https://hyperplane.example/HP-RMA-4572 (internal)
ana_infra: (cc @ana_infra) quick ask: can infra degrade gracefully if 40 fewer GPUs arrive? we have canaries and dedicated pools — propose to temporarily shift non-prod batch jobs to us-east spare fleet and hold back low-priority ETL.
ana_infra: suggested immediate plan: 1) re-route 200 low-priority NRT tasks to us-east-fallback, 2) hold canary expansion for 48h, 3) enable model-quantization profile q4 for long-running jobs to save tokens/cycles. need ops signoff.
devex: cost question — if vendor issues a 30% provisional credit, do we net against committed reserved capacity or refund as account credit? finance prefers refund to committed balance to reduce next invoice.
maria_ops: we need serial-level manifest to reconcile with our inventory. sam, can you push CSV with serial, PO, unit status (DOA/RMA/OK) and AWB per wave?
sam_hyperplane: yes. attaching manifest (link): https://files.hyperplane.example/manifests/HP7-wave7-partial.csv — contains serial,status,AWB,wave. Customs HS stays same. For replacements we will provide consolidated AWB when wave2 ships.
jordan_logistics: please include estimated delivery windows per AWB and incoterms. we may need to prebook crossdock space for wave2.
lee_procure: action items: @sam_hyperplane push CSV + provisional credit note by EOD PST, confirm if replacements will be shipped from EU or CN facility (affects leadtime), and confirm whether vendor covers return shipping for DOA units.
sam_hyperplane: confirmed — return shipping covered, wave1 ships CN origin (3–5 business days to west coast), wave2 will originate EU (7–10 days to EMEA). credit note will be uploaded.
nana_infra: temporary routing approved from infra side. i'll open a short-lived autoscale policy to shift 130 GPUs worth of low-priority work to us-east. ops: can you trim canary by 2 replicas?
maria_ops: trimming canary now. please share the CSV so I can mark serials "pending RMA" in asset tracker.
lee_procure: thanks all. will follow up in procurement ticket. Sam — ping here once credit note uploaded and when AWB numbers are final. :thumbsup:
sam_hyperplane: will do.
